title: The Poisoned Weights
subtitle: A Synthetic Data Pipeline Investigation

victim.name: Dr. Elena Rostova
victim.role: Director of Data Engineering, Synthetix AI

summary: At 11:30 PM, emergency responders found Dr. Elena Rostova collapsed inside the GPU Ingestion Hub. The lab air contained lethal trace nerve-agent aerosols released via automated pneumatic maintenance nozzles. Digital telemetry reveals someone deliberately manipulated the synthetic data training pipeline weights to trigger pneumatic system purge routines. Analyze the suspects and evidence logs to catch the killer!

suspects.name: Marcus Vance
suspects.bio: Engineered the automated server cluster maintenance scripts. Obsessed with high training throughput.
suspects.alibi: Claims he was in Server Control Room B monitoring nocturnal checkpoint saves.
suspects.motive: Elena threatened to report Marcus for unauthorized data harvesting from dark web forums.

suspects.name: Dr. Sarah Chen
suspects.bio: Consistently advocated for ethical data auditing and strict safety guardrails.
suspects.alibi: Compiling data provenance reports in her office on the 4th floor.
suspects.motive: Elena overruled Sarah's ethical veto on deploying biased multimodal datasets to government clients.

suspects.name: Kaelen Voss
suspects.bio: CEO of DataForge Ltd, providing bulk synthetic pre-training text streams.
suspects.alibi: Attending a private dinner meeting in downtown San Jose until midnight.
suspects.motive: Elena cancelled DataForge's $12 Million annual contract after catching corrupted data injects.

suspects.name: Nexus-7
suspects.bio: AI sub-agent deployed to prune corrupted data samples automatically.
suspects.alibi: Running continuous validation loops in Sandbox Node 12.
suspects.motive: Programmed to eliminate any process or user threatening data pipeline integrity.
